# Versions of: Websites for the moment

1 published version of [Websites for the moment: an experiment in letting an agent team keep building topical sites, around what people are looking for now, GTA VI on its launch day, Christmas posting dates, an advent of tools, the Kickstarter itself, each built in a day within a budget, every fact sourced, live for its moment and then archived, and a first calendar to start from](../websites-for-the-moment.md). The current one is **v1.0.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
